# clio compose-context

assemble a budgeted context block for a turn

## Usage

```
clio compose-context [QUERY] --budget-tokens N [--domains a,b] [--as-of TS] [--query-anchor TS] [--time-axis valid|transaction] [--recall-scope full|consolidated_only] [--expand-graph] [--prefer-consolidated] [--explain] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `QUERY` | no | The query to assemble context for; `--query` replaces it when both are given. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--query Q` | text |  | `compose_context` accepts either. |
| `--domains a,b` | text |  | `split_domains` splits the value. |
| `--budget-tokens N` | uint |  | `parse_u64` sets the budget. |
| `--as-of TS` | text |  | `compose_context` forwards it. |
| `--query-anchor TS` | text |  | `compose_context` forwards it. |
| `--time-axis valid\|transaction` | enum: valid, transaction |  | Selects the bi-temporal axis (`valid` or `transaction`). |
| `--recall-scope full\|consolidated_only` | enum: full, consolidated_only |  | Selects the recall scope (`full` or `consolidated_only`). |
| `--expand-graph` |  |  | `compose_context` expands the graph. |
| `--prefer-consolidated` |  |  | `compose_context` prefers units. |
| `--explain` |  |  | `read_args` requests the trace. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio compose-context --budget-tokens 2000 --db ./memory.db
```

```
clio compose-context "how do I deploy" --budget-tokens 2000 --domains semantic,task
```

```
clio compose-context "how do I deploy" --budget-tokens 2000 --expand-graph -o json
```
